About the hotel

Gulberg II mein ek pur-sukoon thikana

Royal Luxury Hotel Lahore ke Gulberg II area mein, 16-C Ghalib Road par waqeh ek 3-star hotel hai. Sirf 10 rooms ke sath ye hotel bheed se door, khamosh aur zaati khidmat wala mahol deta hai — chaahe aap family ke sath aayen ya kaam ke silsile mein.

  • ✓Family aur Twin rooms — sirf yehi do room types hain, families aur saath safar karne walon ke liye.
  • ✓Valet parking — gaari ki fikar khatam, hotel par hi valet sahulat mojood hai.
  • ✓Breakfast — din ki shuruaat hotel ke breakfast ke sath karein.
  • ✓24-hour security — din ho ya raat, mehmanon ki hifazat har waqt.

Rooms — Family & Twin, sirf yehi do

Hotel mein kul 10 rooms hain aur sirf do qisam ke rooms milte hain. Koi aur room type nahi hai — jo hai, wohi yahan saaf likha hai. Availability ke liye call ya WhatsApp par confirm karein.

Family Room

Family ke sath rehne ke liye khula aur aaram-deh kamra. Bachon ke sath aane walon ke liye behtareen intekhab — breakfast, valet parking aur 24-hour security ki sahulat ke sath.

Amenities & services

Breakfast
